brand_vibe: Professional local coaching, authentic Berber hospitality, and a community that feels like home. Focus on world-class point breaks and high-quality gear. Tone should be welcoming, expert, and deeply connected to the local surf culture.

packages.name: Group Surf Class
packages.description: 2 hours of group coaching per day. Includes transfer to the best spot, towel, and premium surfing equipment.

packages.name: Surf & Dine
packages.description: Kick off with a healthy breakfast, catch waves with expert instructors, and unwind with a refreshing shower and a shared lunch.

packages.name: Private Surf Lesson
packages.description: 3 hours of private, one-on-one coaching per day. Includes spot transfer, towel, and high-quality equipment.

packages.name: Surf & Yoga Package
packages.description: The perfect balance of adventure and relaxation. Includes surf coaching, surfboard, wetsuit, and a post-surf yoga session.

daily_schedule.Mid-Day: Surf Sessions (Group or Private) & Transfers to Spots
daily_schedule.Evening: Yoga Shala Sessions & Family Dinners (Most Evenings)
